openwhip-nx.name: OpenWhip NX
openwhip-nx.tagline: Whip Claude into shape — tray whip that interrupts Claude Code and demands FASTER

artifacts.label: Tray app (Linux)
artifacts.postInstallNote: Wayland needs the ydotoold daemon (one-time): installs the ydotool package and enables a ydotoold.service with its socket at /run/ydotoold.sock, owned by your user.
artifacts.postInstallCmd:
sudo pacman -S --needed --noconfirm ydotool && printf '[Unit]
Description=ydotool daemon

[Service]
ExecStart=/usr/bin/ydotoold --socket-path=/run/ydotoold.sock --socket-own=1000:1000
Restart=on-failure

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
' > /etc/systemd/system/ydotoold.service && systemctl daemon-reload && systemctl enable --now ydotoold.service

nx-deck.name: NX Deck
nx-deck.tagline: Your phone as a control deck — media, volume, trackpad, keyboard over the LAN

artifacts.label: Desktop daemon (Linux)
artifacts.postInstallNote: Needs Node ≥ 22 on PATH. Launch it, then read the deck URL it prints (or run ~/Applications/nx/nx-deck/archive-dir-linux/nx-deck in a terminal to see it) and open that on your phone — the token in the URL is the key, keep it on your own LAN. Trackpad & keyboard need a writable /dev/uinput: sudo setfacl -m u:$USER:rw /dev/uinput (see the README for a persistent udev rule).

nx-hub.name: NX Hub
nx-hub.tagline: This launcher — installs and updates itself

nx-nebula.name: NX Nebula
nx-nebula.tagline: Living nebula wallpaper for KDE Plasma — clock, gallery, ultrawide-aware

artifacts.label: Plasma live wallpaper
artifacts.postInstallNote: Right-click the desktop → Desktop and Wallpaper → type 'NX Nebula (Live)'. After an update, run the restart command so Plasma reloads the QML and the pointer-bridge helper picks up its new binary.
artifacts.postInstallCmd: systemctl --user try-restart nx-cursor.service; systemctl --user restart plasma-plasmashell.service

nx-kde.name: NX for KDE
nx-kde.tagline: The whole desktop in NX — Global Theme for Plasma 6

artifacts.label: Plasma 6 theme suite
artifacts.postInstallNote: Apply via System Settings → Colors & Themes → Global Theme → NX. Pairs with NX Nebula for a living wallpaper. Login screen (SDDM) needs root: clone the repo and run ./install.sh --sddm

nx-blender.name: NX for Blender
nx-blender.tagline: The NX design language as a complete Blender theme

artifacts.label: Blender theme
artifacts.postInstallNote: Apply it in Blender: Edit → Preferences → Themes → Presets → NX. Installed into every Blender version found on this machine.

nx-atelier.name: NX Atelier
nx-atelier.tagline: A painting suite for Blender — 176 procedural brushes

artifacts.label: Blender addon
artifacts.postInstallNote: Enable it in Blender: Edit → Preferences → Add-ons → search "NX Atelier". Then open the 3D viewport sidebar (N) → Atelier tab → Build Brush Library. That generates all 176 brushes on this machine and takes a few seconds, once.

nx-flick.name: NX Flick
nx-flick.tagline: Motorola-style motion shortcuts — chop for the flashlight, twist for the camera

artifacts.label: Android APK
artifacts.postInstallNote: Open NX Flick and work through the Setup checklist. Unrestricted battery is the one that matters — without it Android eventually dozes the watcher and gestures stop firing. Chop chop and twist twist are on by default.

nx-wisp.name: NX Wisp
nx-wisp.tagline: A creature that lives on your desktop

artifacts.label: Desktop companion
artifacts.postInstallNote: Her language models (~1-19 GB, pinned sha256) are fetched once, on demand: click Run, or `nx-wisp models fetch` in a terminal. You can also just ask her to fetch them, once model.allow_downloads is on.
